turns.answer:
The Concierge couldn't be summoned. A hook in this session blocked the spawn ("Not available in this session"), so I did the reading myself. I haven't written anything to the palace.

**What I took "the pitch" to be.** No file is called that. The closest thing is the channel copy in `Projects/Loudon Live/Loudon Live — launch kit.md`: the tagline, the About text and the trailer script (§1–3). It's also out of date. It was written in May for a channel that only streamed, and the entry now covers Read The Manual, videos and streams, and coaching (`Projects/Loudon Live.md:61-66`).

**The tension, said once.** The palace takes a position on this exact request. `Quality Manifesto.md:137` puts "optimized thumbnail/title (clickbait that works)" on the side it calls their paradigm, not yours. The design system's floor says "No hype" and no outcome-promising titles (`Palace development/Loudon Live Design System.md:260`). It's your channel, so I've written for clicks anyway. Two lines I kept:
- **Nothing promises what a video doesn't deliver.** That's about honesty, not taste.
- **The subject stays sound, not gear.** The entry rejected a tools-first identity (`Projects/Loudon Live.md:112`).

---

### Tagline (banner)

> **Better sounds from the gear you already have.**
> Synthesis, sound design and music technique, on video and live.

### About

> Better sounds from the gear you already have. I'm Loudon. I've taught music for [N] years, and this is where I show electronic musicians how sound actually works, one real project at a time.
>
> What you'll find here:
>
> **Read The Manual.** One instrument's whole manual, tested and explained, one short video per section. Jump to the part you're stuck on and get unstuck in a few minutes.
>
> **Builds.** Synths, effects and tools made from scratch, including the parts that don't work yet.
>
> **Sound itself.** Why a sound feels warm, why a phrase lands, what your ears are actually doing.
>
> Some of it's live. One project pushed forward, chat open the whole time, so ask anything.
>
> I also coach one-on-one, online and in person: [link]
>
> If you teach yourself things (lots of things), you're in the right place. Subscribe and you'll catch the next one.

**Short bio:**
> Better sounds from the gear you already have. Synths, sound design, and manuals read cover to cover.

### Trailer (~60 seconds)

> *[Cold open, no hello: a patch mid-build. One move takes it from thin to huge.]*
>
> That's one knob. This channel is about knowing which one, and why it works.
>
> I'm Loudon, this is Loudon Live. I've taught music for a long time, and here I teach electronic musicians how sound actually works.
>
> Three things live here. Read The Manual: I take one instrument's whole manual and cover it a section at a time, so you can go straight to the part you need. Builds: synths and effects made from scratch, on camera, including when they break. And sound itself: why a sound feels warm, why a phrase works, what your ears are doing.
>
> Some of it's live. Chat's open, so ask me anything while I work.
>
> The channel's new and I'm still finding its shape. The work is the point.
>
> If you teach yourself things, subscribe. Let's make something.

---

**What changed:**
- **The payoff comes first, not the identity.** The opening line is what shows up in search previews.
- **Read The Manual leads,** because "how do I do X on my [instrument]" is a search people really make.
- **The trailer opens on a sound,** so nobody leaves during a hello.
- **The work-in-progress note** sits late and takes one line. The entry wants it said once, in the trailer.
- **The [N] is a placeholder.** I didn't want to make up your years of teaching.

**Where clicks actually come from.** On YouTube, most clicks come from titles and thumbnails, not the About page. That's general knowledge about the platform, not something I checked here. The kit's title patterns, like "Synth lab · session 3" (§4), were built on purpose to promise nothing. That's where this tension really bites, and it's a bigger call than the pitch. I can draft click-oriented title patterns next if you want.

**Where this goes.** Say yes and I'll put it into §1–3 of the launch kit. The Concierge can't take the write this session, so either say "grow up" and I'll do it myself, or keep it here in chat for now.
